description: Runs Vite production build and returns structured output files with sizes.

base.description: Public base path for non-root deployments (maps to --base)

config.description: Path to Vite config file (maps to --config)

emptyOutDir.description: Empty the output directory before building (maps to --emptyOutDir)

logLevel.description: Log level to control output verbosity

manifest.description: Generate a manifest.json for backend-integrated builds (maps to --manifest)

minify.description: Minification strategy (esbuild, terser, or false to disable)

reportCompressedSize.description: Report compressed (gzip) size of output files — disable to speed up large builds

sourcemap.description: Generate source maps. true for default, 'inline' for inline, 'hidden' for hidden source maps.

name: vite-build
title: Vite Build
